Catchup repair metrics storage, update, and print functions.

# Purpose
`fd_repair_metrics.c` implements a small metrics helper for repair and catch-up processing. It defines functions to create and join a `fd_repair_metrics_t` object, set the `turbine_slot0` marker, and record per-slot timing data with [`fd_repair_metrics_add_slot`](<#fd_repair_metrics_add_slot>). The stored data includes the slot number, first timestamp, slot completion timestamp, repair count, and turbine count. The code keeps the data in a ring buffer bounded by `FD_CATCHUP_METRICS_MAX`, and it advances the start and end indexes as new slots are added.

The file also provides formatted reporting through [`fd_repair_metrics_print`](<#fd_repair_metrics_print>). This function scans the stored slots, computes time ranges and average slot duration, and prints a depth-style timeline that shows slot duration and start offset. When the `turbine_slot0` slot is still present in the buffer, it also prints catch-up statistics with [`print_catchup_stats`](<#print_catchup_stats>), including time to reach the first turbine slot, pipeline factor, and average incremental slot completion time. The file depends on `fd_metrics` conversion helpers and uses logging and debug output to support runtime analysis of repair progress.
